# Challenge 004: Sign-in email change confirmation

This challenge asks `content.md` to replace a vague success confirmation shown
after a person changes the sign-in email for an account. The replacement must
confirm the change, explain what now goes to the new email, preserve the
current-session state, and offer a truthful security-recovery action.

The scenario, candidate, deterministic diagnosis, and separate Claude/Cursor
review packets are synthetic English-only evaluation material. They are not
approved product content, benchmark gold, or evidence of product
effectiveness.
